verdict.rationale: SigNoz is documented as an OpenTelemetry-native platform that ingests telemetry emitted by standard OpenTelemetry libraries over OTLP. That means instrumentation is vendor-neutral rather than SigNoz-specific, and community users cite its OpenTelemetry basis as a reason to move off Datadog. Portability is implied by the open standard, not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation that apps can switch to or away from SigNoz by repointing the OTLP exporter alone, and hands-on corroboration of a backend switch with no code changes.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument once with open standards and switch backends without re-instrumenting my code

citations.quote: SigNoz Cloud brings your traces, metrics, and logs into one OpenTelemetry-native platform.
Your application emits gen_ai.* spans and metrics through standard OpenTelemetry libraries, exports them over OTLP, and SigNoz stores and queries them next to the rest of your application telemetry.
you can migrate one signal type at a time while running both platforms in parallel.
